summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares International Dividend Growth ETF (IGRO) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund tracks an index of international equities that have growing dividends. IGRO was launched on May 17, 2016 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: IGRO is an equity ETF with a total of 579 individual holdings. The top holdings are British American Tobacco p.l.c. stock at 3.09%, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company at 3.09%, Nestlé at 2.93%, Novartis AG at 2.89%, and Roche Holding AG at 2.88%.
